prompt:
Locked-off camera at desk height. The woman in the camel cardigan keeps ranting over his shoulder, jabbing her raised finger at his screen, her mouth moving fast, her head bobbing with each point. The bald man in the blue checked shirt does not react at all: he keeps typing slowly, eyes on his monitor, face completely flat, one slow bored blink, a tiny unimpressed exhale through his nose, his hands staying on the keyboard; he never looks up at her. Behind them the office carries on, a colleague walks past in the background. Movement continues right to the last frame. Sound: an open-plan office hum, keyboard taps. No music.

Thanks.
